item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Bilal’s known bar magnet with its South pole facing unmarked bar Y. The facing ends push apart.

What does this tell him about bar Y?

options.A: Bar Y is a magnet; only a magnet can repel another magnet.
options.B: Bar Y is ordinary iron; attraction alone would already prove it is a magnet.
options.C: Bar Y is a magnet because both bars are drawn the same length.
options.D: Bar Y is a magnet only if a North pole attracts it, not if the ends push apart.
